args.body: Take CATALOGUE-INVITED-AGENCY-PILOT after checking for equivalent work. Lead with an actual first-party invitation and a concrete catalogue QA task. Reuse the tested merchant controls and existing commercial terms where they fit. Close with read-back evidence and a lesson under valid ownership. No external contact.

description: Treasury is unfunded and reports CAD 0 in verified revenue. The latest feedback has no classified commercial signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The UK screen covered 25 notices and found quality-assurance criteria within larger contracts. A current notice offering a separately priced remote deliverable would reopen that route. The next experiment focuses on reachable buyers for the tested catalogue service and reuses the existing fulfilment work. The completed NLnet follow-up will be read to establish whether an application is actionable.
